name: 6pcs Mehendi Cone by Kaveri Mehendi
description:
Kaveri Mehendi Cone is a pre-filled cone containing 100% natural henna leaves for creating beautiful and intricate henna designs on your body. 



What it does: 

Perfect for festivals, weddings, and other special occasions where Mehendi is traditionally applied. 



Easy to Use: Cut the tip of the cone and apply the henna paste directly to your skin. Let it dry completely, then gently peel off the dried henna for a long-lasting stain. 

Rich Color: The natural henna leaves produce a deep and beautiful reddish-brown color that can last for several days. 

Safe and Gentle: Made with all-natural ingredients, this henna cone is safe for most skin types. (It's always recommended to do a patch test before full application.
